modules.trigger_bot.name: TriggerBot
modules.trigger_bot.desc: Attacks whatever the crosshair is on, as fast as you could
modules.trigger_bot.TARGETS.name: Targets
modules.trigger_bot.TARGETS.tip: Which entity kinds count as a target, shared with AimAssist
modules.trigger_bot.DELAY.name: Delay
modules.trigger_bot.DELAY.tip: Milliseconds between swings, rolled fresh inside this range every time
modules.trigger_bot.WAIT_FOR_COOLDOWN.ti: Only swing once the attack indicator has fully recharged
modules.trigger_bot.REQUIRE_WEAPON.name: Require weapon
modules.trigger_bot.REQUIRE_WEAPON.tip: Only swing while holding a sword, axe, mace or trident
modules.aim_assist.name: AimAssist
modules.aim_assist.desc: Helps your aim onto the target nearest your crosshair
modules.aim_assist.TARGETS.name: Targets
modules.aim_assist.TARGETS.tip: Which entity kinds may be aimed at, shared with TriggerBot
modules.aim_assist.RANGE.name: Range
modules.aim_assist.RANGE.tip: How far away in blocks a target may be
modules.aim_assist.FOV.name: FOV
modules.aim_assist.FOV.tip: Width in degrees of the cone ahead of you a target has to be inside
modules.aim_assist.STRENGTH.name: Strength
modules.aim_assist.STRENGTH.tip: Percent of your own mouse movement added on top of it toward the target, so 100 turns twice as fast
modules.aim_assist.FRICTION.name: Friction
modules.aim_assist.FRICTION.tip: Percent of your own mouse movement swallowed when you drag off a target, full on it and none at the edge of the cone
modules.aim_assist.PULL.name: Pull
modules.aim_assist.PULL.tip: Degrees per second it turns toward the target with your mouse still, 0 for off
modules.aim_assist.REACTION.name: Reaction
modules.aim_assist.REACTION.tip: Milliseconds a newly acquired target is left alone for, rolled inside this range
modules.aim_assist.CLICK_ONLY.name: Click only
modules.aim_assist.CLICK_ONLY.tip: Only help while the attack button is held
modules.aim_assist.IGNORE_WALLS.name: Ignore walls
modules.aim_assist.IGNORE_WALLS.tip: Keep pulling toward a target that has stepped behind blocks
modules.auto_mace.name: AutoMace
modules.auto_mace.desc: Smashes the nearest target with your mace while you fall, swapping to it for the hit
modules.auto_mace.TARGETS.name: Targets
modules.auto_mace.TARGETS.tip: Which entity kinds may be hit, shared with TriggerBot and AimAssist
modules.auto_mace.MIN_FALL.name: Min fall
modules.auto_mace.MIN_FALL.tip: Blocks fallen before it swings. The server only smashes past 1.5
modules.auto_mace.RANGE.name: Range
modules.auto_mace.RANGE.tip: Blocks from your eye to the target's hitbox, where vanilla reach is 3
modules.auto_mace.FOV.name: FOV
modules.auto_mace.FOV.tip: Width in degrees of the cone around your view a target must be inside, 360 for anywhere
modules.auto_mace.COOLDOWN.name: Cooldown
modules.auto_mace.COOLDOWN.tip: Percent the held item's attack should have recharged. Over 90 lands a critical hit. Waited for while the fall allows, else it smashes anyway at the last tick in reach
modules.auto_mace.WAIT_CHARGE.name: Wait for charge
modules.auto_mace.WAIT_CHARGE.tip: Never swing short of Cooldown, even when the fall ends first. Off smashes anyway
modules.auto_mace.STOP_SPRINT.name: Stop sprint
modules.auto_mace.STOP_SPRINT.tip: Let go of forward for the ticks before a planned critical hit so the sprint ends, as releasing W does. The server refuses a crit while sprinting
modules.auto_mace.SILENT.name: Silent
modules.auto_mace.SILENT.tip: Turn the look sent to the server, a tick before the hit, and leave the camera alone. Off turns the camera
modules.auto_mace.TURN.name: Turn speed
modules.auto_mace.TURN.tip: Degrees per second the aim may travel, rolled fresh inside this range for every target
modules.auto_mace.AIM.name: Aim point
modules.auto_mace.AIM.tip: Where on the hitbox the aim goes. Nearest turns the least
modules.auto_mace.MOVE_FIX.name: Move fix
modules.auto_mace.MOVE_FIX.tip: While the sent look is off your camera, re-pick the walk keys so you keep heading the same way
modules.auto_mace.SLOT.name: Mace slot
modules.auto_mace.SLOT.tip: Hotbar slot the mace is taken from. Auto keeps a held one, else takes the first
modules.auto_mace.SWAP_BACK.name: Swap back
modules.auto_mace.SWAP_BACK.tip: Go back to the item you were holding once the hit is sent
modules.auto_mace.WALLS.name: Through walls
modules.auto_mace.WALLS.tip: Hit a target with blocks in between, which no hand could aim at
modules.auto_totem.name: AutoTotem
modules.auto_totem.desc: Keeps a Totem of Undying in your offhand, always or when the next hit could kill
modules.auto_totem.MODE.name: Mode
modules.auto_totem.MODE.tip: Always refills the offhand whenever it has no totem. Smart waits until one of the checks below fires
modules.auto_totem.HEALTH.name: Health
modules.auto_totem.HEALTH.tip: Equip at or under this much health, absorption included. 2 is one heart
modules.auto_totem.ELYTRA.name: Elytra
modules.auto_totem.FALL.name: Fall
modules.auto_totem.FALL.tip: Equip when the landing below would deal at least your health in fall damage
modules.auto_totem.EXPLOSION.name: Explosion
modules.auto_totem.EXPLOSION.tip: Equip when crystals, lit TNT and swelling creepers in range could deal at least your health
modules.auto_totem.MAINHAND.name: Mainhand backup
modules.auto_totem.MAINHAND.tip: With a slot screen open, the offhand already holding a totem and a check above firing, swap a second totem into the held hotbar slot. Once the screen is shut and the offhand has used its totem, F moves this one across
modules.auto_totem.ILLEGIT.name: Illegit
modules.auto_totem.ILLEGIT.tip: Click the totem straight into the offhand under any screen or none, whatever the cursor holds, instead of only the moves a hand can make
modules.auto_totem.DELAY.name: Delay
modules.auto_totem.DELAY.tip: Milliseconds after a move before the next one, rolled fresh inside this range
modules.crystal_aura.name: CrystalAura
modules.crystal_aura.desc: Places end crystals where they hurt a target most and breaks them
modules.crystal_aura.TARGETS.name: Targets
modules.crystal_aura.TARGETS.tip: Which entity kinds may be targeted, shared with TriggerBot and AimAssist
modules.crystal_aura.STRICT.name: Strict
modules.crystal_aura.STRICT.tip: Only clicks a hand could make: every look the server may check is on the block or crystal, survival reach, nothing through walls, Silent's slot kept a tick. Off lifts all four
modules.crystal_aura.TARGET_RANGE.name: Target range
modules.crystal_aura.TARGET_RANGE.tip: Blocks from you a target may stand
modules.crystal_aura.MIN_DAMAGE.name: Min damage
modules.crystal_aura.MIN_DAMAGE.tip: Least a crystal must deal the target, where 2 is one heart
modules.crystal_aura.MAX_SELF.name: Max self damage
modules.crystal_aura.MAX_SELF.tip: Most a crystal may deal you
modules.crystal_aura.ANTI_SUICIDE.name: Anti suicide
modules.crystal_aura.ANTI_SUICIDE.tip: Never place or break a crystal that would take all your health, absorption included
modules.crystal_aura.PLACE.name: Place
modules.crystal_aura.PLACE.tip: Place crystals on obsidian and bedrock
modules.crystal_aura.PLACE_DELAY.name: Place delay
modules.crystal_aura.PLACE_DELAY.tip: Milliseconds between placements, rolled fresh inside this range
modules.crystal_aura.PLACE_RANGE.name: Place range
modules.crystal_aura.PLACE_RANGE.tip: Blocks from your eye to the clicked block. Strict holds it to 4.5, survival block reach
modules.crystal_aura.BREAK.name: Break
modules.crystal_aura.BREAK.tip: Hit crystals that hurt a target enough
modules.crystal_aura.BREAK_DELAY.name: Break delay
modules.crystal_aura.BREAK_DELAY.tip: Milliseconds between hits, rolled fresh inside this range
modules.crystal_aura.BREAK_RANGE.name: Break range
modules.crystal_aura.BREAK_RANGE.tip: Blocks from your eye to the crystal's hitbox. Strict holds it to 3, survival attack reach
modules.crystal_aura.FAST_BREAK.name: Fast break
modules.crystal_aura.FAST_BREAK.tip: Hit a crystal you placed as soon as it appears, without waiting out Break delay. Off by default: no hand reacts in the tick a crystal spawns
modules.crystal_aura.ATTEMPTS.name: Break attempts
modules.crystal_aura.ATTEMPTS.tip: Hits on one crystal before giving up on it
modules.crystal_aura.FACE_PLACE.name: Face place
modules.crystal_aura.FACE_PLACE.tip: Drop Min damage to 1.5 against a target at or under Face health, or wearing a nearly broken piece
modules.crystal_aura.FACE_HEALTH.name: Face health
modules.crystal_aura.FACE_HEALTH.tip: Target health, absorption included, at or under which Face place starts
modules.crystal_aura.FACE_DURABILITY.tip: Percent durability left on any worn piece at or under which Face place starts
modules.crystal_aura.SWITCH.name: Switch
modules.crystal_aura.SWITCH.tip: Normal moves to the crystals and stays. Silent goes back afterwards. Off only places while crystals are held
modules.crystal_aura.ANTI_WEAKNESS.name: Anti weakness
modules.crystal_aura.ANTI_WEAKNESS.tip: Under Weakness, take a weapon from the hotbar for the hit, since a bare hand deals nothing
modules.crystal_aura.TURN.name: Turn speed
modules.crystal_aura.TURN.tip: Degrees per second the sent look may travel, rolled fresh inside this range for every new spot
modules.crystal_aura.MOVE_FIX.name: Move fix
modules.crystal_aura.MOVE_FIX.tip: While the sent look is off your camera, re-pick the walk keys so you keep heading the same way
modules.crystal_aura.PAUSE_EAT.name: Pause while using
modules.crystal_aura.PAUSE_EAT.tip: Do nothing while you eat, drink or hold any use
modules.crystal_aura.RENDER.name: Render
modules.crystal_aura.RENDER.tip: Outline the block the next crystal goes on
modules.safe_anchor.name: SafeAnchor
modules.safe_anchor.desc: After you place a respawn anchor, charges it with one glowstone and puts a glowstone block between you and it
modules.safe_anchor.SHIELD.name: Shield
modules.safe_anchor.SHIELD.tip: After the charge, place a glowstone block in the cell between you and the anchor to take the blast. Skipped when you stand in that cell
modules.safe_anchor.SILENT.name: Silent
modules.safe_anchor.SILENT.tip: Turn only the look sent to the server and leave the camera alone. Off turns the camera, so you see each click being aimed
modules.safe_anchor.TURN.name: Turn speed
modules.safe_anchor.TURN.tip: Degrees per second the aim may travel, rolled fresh inside this range for every anchor
modules.safe_anchor.MOVE_FIX.name: Move fix
modules.safe_anchor.MOVE_FIX.tip: While the sent look is off your camera, re-pick the walk keys so you keep heading the same way
modules.safe_anchor.SWAP_BACK.name: Swap back
modules.safe_anchor.SWAP_BACK.tip: Go back to the item you were holding once the glowstone is used
modules.safe_anchor.HOLD.name: Hold to detonate
modules.safe_anchor.HOLD.tip: Let a held right click set off a charged anchor, so you can hold the button instead of clicking. Off keeps every held click off anchors; only a fresh press detonates
modules.crystal_macro.name: CrystalMacro
modules.crystal_macro.desc: Hold right click with end crystals to place them on the obsidian or bedrock you look at and break the crystal you look at
modules.crystal_macro.PLACE_DELAY.name: Place delay
modules.crystal_macro.PLACE_DELAY.tip: Milliseconds between placements, rolled fresh inside this range. A tick is 50
modules.crystal_macro.BREAK_DELAY.name: Break delay
modules.crystal_macro.BREAK_DELAY.tip: Milliseconds between hits, rolled fresh inside this range. A tick is 50
modules.xray.name: Xray
modules.xray.desc: Draws chosen blocks through terrain, each in its own colour
modules.xray.BLOCKS.name: Blocks
modules.xray.BLOCKS.tip: Which blocks are drawn through terrain, and in what colour
modules.xray.LAVA.name: Show lava
modules.xray.LAVA.tip: Draw lava in red, whether or not it is switched on in Blocks
modules.xray.LAVRENDER.name: Lavrender
modules.xray.LAVRENDER.tip: Fade lava out with distance, so lava near you is strong and a far lava sea barely shows. Off draws all lava at the same opacity
modules.xray.EXPOSED.name: Exposed only
modules.xray.EXPOSED.tip: Draw only blocks with at least one side open to air, a fluid or a block that is not a full cube
modules.xray.RANGE.name: Range
modules.xray.RANGE.tip: How far from you in blocks the sweep looks
modules.xray.SHAPE.name: Shape
modules.xray.SHAPE.tip: Lines draws the outline of a shape, Sides fills its faces, Both does each
modules.xray.FILL.name: Fill
modules.xray.FILL.tip: How solid the filled faces are, 0 to 255
modules.block_esp.name: BlockEsp
modules.block_esp.desc: Draws the blocks you pick through terrain; none ship switched on
modules.block_esp.BLOCKS.name: Blocks
modules.block_esp.BLOCKS.tip: Which blocks are drawn through terrain, and in what colour
modules.block_esp.RANGE.name: Range
modules.block_esp.RANGE.tip: How far from you in blocks the sweep looks
modules.block_esp.SHAPE.name: Shape
modules.block_esp.SHAPE.tip: Lines draws the outline of a shape, Sides fills its faces, Both does each
modules.block_esp.FILL.name: Fill
modules.block_esp.FILL.tip: How solid the filled faces are, 0 to 255
modules.ore_esp.name: OreEsp
modules.ore_esp.desc: Draws every ore through terrain, each in its own colour
modules.ore_esp.BLOCKS.name: Blocks
modules.ore_esp.BLOCKS.tip: Which ores are drawn through terrain, and in what colour
modules.ore_esp.EXPOSED.name: Exposed only
modules.ore_esp.EXPOSED.tip: Draw only blocks with at least one side open to air, a fluid or a block that is not a full cube
modules.ore_esp.RANGE.name: Range
modules.ore_esp.RANGE.tip: How far from you in blocks the sweep looks
modules.ore_esp.SHAPE.name: Shape
modules.ore_esp.SHAPE.tip: Lines draws the outline of a shape, Sides fills its faces, Both does each
modules.ore_esp.FILL.name: Fill
modules.ore_esp.FILL.tip: How solid the filled faces are, 0 to 255
modules.seed_xray.name: SeedXray
modules.seed_xray.desc: Works out where the ores are from the world seed, hidden ones included
modules.seed_xray.SEED.name: Seed
modules.seed_xray.SEED.tip: The world's seed, a number or the text it was made from
modules.seed_xray.BLOCKS.name: Ores
modules.seed_xray.BLOCKS.tip: Which ores are drawn, and in what colour
modules.seed_xray.RANGE.name: Range
modules.seed_xray.RANGE.tip: How far from you in blocks ores are worked out and drawn
modules.seed_xray.SHAPE.name: Shape
modules.seed_xray.SHAPE.tip: Lines draws the outline of a shape, Sides fills its faces, Both does each
modules.seed_xray.FILL.name: Fill
modules.seed_xray.FILL.tip: How solid the filled faces are, 0 to 255
modules.sound_esp.name: SoundEsp
modules.sound_esp.desc: Searches for sounds that do not occur naturally, to find a base
modules.sound_esp.SOUNDS.name: Sounds
modules.sound_esp.SOUNDS.tip: Which sounds mark their block, and in what colour
modules.sound_esp.DURATION.name: Duration
modules.sound_esp.DURATION.tip: Seconds a block stays marked after its sound; type a number for longer than the bar
modules.sound_esp.SHAPE.name: Shape
modules.sound_esp.SHAPE.tip: Lines draws the outline of a shape, Sides fills its faces, Both does each
modules.sound_esp.FILL.name: Fill
modules.sound_esp.FILL.tip: How solid the filled faces are, 0 to 255
modules.basefinder.name: Basefinder
modules.basefinder.desc: Outlines chunks with signs of players: grown amethyst, grown or cut plants and placed blocks
modules.basefinder.AMETHYST.name: Amethyst
modules.basefinder.AMETHYST.tip: Score geodes whose bud stages are too skewed to be fresh from generation
modules.basefinder.KELP.name: Grown kelp
modules.basefinder.KELP.tip: Score kelp that has grown past the ages generation gives it
modules.basefinder.BROKEN.name: Cut plants
modules.basefinder.BROKEN.tip: Score kelp and nether vines whose tip was broken off
modules.basefinder.CANE.name: Grown sugar cane
modules.basefinder.CANE.tip: Score sugar cane that has aged since generation; a farm has many, one or two can be a passing player
modules.basefinder.PLACED.name: Placed blocks
modules.basefinder.PLACED.tip: Score blocks no structure generates, like shulker boxes, beacons and lit furnaces
modules.basefinder.MIN_BUDS.name: Min buds
modules.basefinder.MIN_BUDS.tip: Amethyst buds a geode needs before its stages are tested
modules.basefinder.MIN_SCORE.name: Min score
modules.basefinder.MIN_SCORE.tip: Score out of 100 a chunk needs to be outlined
modules.basefinder.RANGE.name: Range
modules.basefinder.RANGE.tip: How far from you in chunks outlines are drawn
modules.basefinder.EVIDENCE.name: Show evidence
modules.basefinder.EVIDENCE.tip: Also box each block that counted, coloured by signal
modules.new_chunks.name: NewChunks
modules.new_chunks.desc: Marks chunks generated as you load them, from liquid that starts flowing next to a source. Only chunks loaded while this is on
modules.new_chunks.SHOW_OLD.name: Show old
modules.new_chunks.SHOW_OLD.tip: Also mark chunks that already held flowing liquid when they arrived
modules.new_chunks.HEIGHT.name: Height
modules.new_chunks.HEIGHT.tip: Y level the marks are drawn at
modules.new_chunks.RANGE.name: Range
modules.new_chunks.RANGE.tip: How far from you in chunks marks are drawn
modules.seed_cracker.name: SeedCracker
modules.seed_cracker.desc: Works out the world seed from structures, End pillars and decorations
modules.seed_cracker.FINDERS.name: Finders
modules.seed_cracker.FINDERS.tip: Which structures and decorations are looked for
modules.seed_cracker.BEDROCK.name: Bedrock
modules.seed_cracker.BEDROCK.tip: Also read the bedrock at the bottom and top of the Nether and the bottom of the Overworld
modules.seed_cracker.MODE.name: Mode
modules.seed_cracker.MODE.tip: Fast also lifts from finds that are not key and filters candidates sooner
modules.seed_cracker.SHOW_BOXES.name: Show boxes
modules.seed_cracker.SHOW_BOXES.tip: Draw what each finder matched, in its colour
modules.seed_cracker.SEND.name: Send to Seed Xray
modules.seed_cracker.SEND.tip: Put a found seed into Seed Xray's Seed setting
modules.seed_cracker.HELP.name: Help
modules.seed_cracker.HELP.tip: What to look for, and which finds are key
modules.seed_cracker.HUD.name: HUD
modules.seed_cracker.HUD.tip: Show progress in a HUD panel instead of chat; the found seed still goes to chat to copy
modules.seed_cracker.SHARE.name: Share
modules.seed_cracker.SHARE.tip: Copy this world's finds as text, for a friend to import and search with
modules.seed_cracker.FRIEND.name: Friend's share
modules.seed_cracker.FRIEND.tip: Paste a friend's copied finds here, then press Import
modules.seed_cracker.IMPORT.name: Import
modules.seed_cracker.IMPORT.tip: Same hashed seed as yours: adds their finds. Another: switches to their world, yours stays cached
modules.storage_esp.name: StorageEsp
modules.storage_esp.desc: Draws chests, shulkers and furnaces through terrain
modules.storage_esp.BLOCKS.name: Blocks
modules.storage_esp.BLOCKS.tip: Which containers are drawn through terrain, and in what colour
modules.storage_esp.RANGE.name: Range
modules.storage_esp.RANGE.tip: How far from you in blocks the sweep looks
modules.storage_esp.SHAPE.name: Shape
modules.storage_esp.SHAPE.tip: Lines draws the outline of a shape, Sides fills its faces, Both does each
modules.storage_esp.FILL.name: Fill
modules.storage_esp.FILL.tip: How solid the filled faces are, 0 to 255
modules.player_esp.name: PlayerEsp
modules.player_esp.desc: Draws every player's hitbox through terrain, friends in the accent colour, and other entities if picked
modules.player_esp.SHAPE.name: Shape
modules.player_esp.SHAPE.tip: Lines draws the outline of a shape, Sides fills its faces, Both does each
modules.player_esp.FILL.name: Fill
modules.player_esp.FILL.tip: How solid the filled faces are, 0 to 255
modules.player_esp.TRACERS.name: Tracers
modules.player_esp.TRACERS.tip: Draw a line from the crosshair to each player
modules.player_esp.FRIEND_COLOR.name: Friend color
modules.player_esp.FRIEND_COLOR.tip: Draw friends in the click GUI's accent colour instead of white
modules.player_esp.ENTITIES.name: Entities
modules.player_esp.ENTITIES.tip: Also draw mobs and other entities, the ones picked in the list below
modules.player_esp.ENTITY_LIST.name: Entity list
modules.player_esp.ENTITY_LIST.tip: Which entities are drawn, and in what colour
modules.nametags.name: Nametags
modules.nametags.desc: Enlarges player names and shows health, gamemode, distance, armor and held items
modules.nametags.SCALE.name: Scale
modules.nametags.SIZING.name: Sizing
modules.nametags.SIZING.tip: Whether a tag shrinks with distance like vanilla or stays one size at any range
modules.nametags.HEALTH.name: Health
modules.nametags.HEALTH.tip: How much health is left, as a number after the name, a bar above it, or both
modules.nametags.GAMEMODE.name: Gamemode
modules.nametags.GAMEMODE.tip: Show each player's gamemode, and mark one the tab list has never heard of
modules.nametags.DISTANCE.name: Distance
modules.nametags.ARMOR.name: Armor
modules.nametags.ARMOR.tip: Draw each player's armor above the name, as Meteor does
modules.nametags.HELD.name: Held Item
modules.nametags.HELD.tip: Add the main hand item before the armor and the offhand item after it
modules.nametags.DURABILITY.name: Durability
modules.nametags.DURABILITY.tip: The item's own bar only, or the bar with the uses left or the percentage left written above it
modules.nametags.ENCHANTS.name: Enchants
modules.nametags.ENCHANTS.tip: List each piece's enchantments above it, cut to three letters and a level
modules.nametags.ITEMS.name: Items
modules.nametags.ITEMS.tip: Show the name of every dropped item within vanilla's 64 block tag range
modules.nametags.ITEM_COUNT.name: Item Count
modules.nametags.ITEM_COUNT.tip: Write the stack size in gray after a dropped item's name when it holds more than one
modules.nametags.ITEM_DISTANCE.name: Item Distance
modules.nametags.ITEM_DISTANCE.tip: Write the distance after a dropped item's name, as Distance does for players
modules.zoom.name: Zoom
modules.zoom.desc: Eases the camera's field of view in on toggle, and back out again
modules.zoom.FOV.name: Fov
modules.zoom.FOV.tip: Degrees the camera eases to while zoomed in
modules.zoom.DURATION.name: Duration
modules.zoom.DURATION.tip: Seconds the zoom takes to ease in or out
modules.zoom.SLOW_LOOK.name: Slow look
modules.zoom.SLOW_LOOK.tip: Turn slower while zoomed, by the zoomed FOV over the normal one, so the mouse moves the crosshair across the same share of the view
modules.extra_hud.name: ExtraHud
modules.extra_hud.desc: Adds HUD panels: your armor, its durability and a low durability warning
modules.extra_hud.SHOWN.name: Shown
modules.extra_hud.SHOWN.tip: Which armor slots get a box: all four, all four while any is worn, worn pieces, or pieces below the warning
modules.extra_hud.VERTICAL.name: Vertical
modules.extra_hud.VERTICAL.tip: Stack the slots in a column instead of a row
modules.extra_hud.REVERSED.name: Reversed
modules.extra_hud.REVERSED.tip: Boots first instead of the helmet
modules.extra_hud.BACKGROUND.name: Background
modules.extra_hud.BACKGROUND.tip: Draw the hotbar's slot frame behind the pieces
modules.extra_hud.EMPTY_ICONS.name: Empty icons
modules.extra_hud.EMPTY_ICONS.tip: Draw the inventory's outline icon in an empty slot
modules.extra_hud.DURABILITY.name: Durability
modules.extra_hud.DURABILITY.tip: The item's own bar only, or the bar with the uses left or the percentage left written beside it
modules.extra_hud.WARNING.name: Warning
modules.extra_hud.WARNING.tip: Show a warning icon over a piece about to break
modules.extra_hud.MIN_LEFT.name: Uses left
modules.extra_hud.MIN_LEFT.tip: Warn at or below this many uses left
modules.extra_hud.MIN_PERCENT.name: Percent left
modules.extra_hud.MIN_PERCENT.tip: Warn at or below this percentage of durability left
modules.extra_hud.BOB.name: Bob
modules.extra_hud.BOB.tip: How many pixels the warning icon jitters by, 0 for still
modules.fullbright.name: Fullbright
modules.fullbright.desc: Draws the world at full light, either baked into the meshes or as a night vision floor on the lightmap
modules.fullbright.MODE.name: Mode
modules.fullbright.MODE.tip: Lighting bakes full light into every chunk mesh and remeshes the world on a switch. Night Vision raises the lightmap floor instead, with no remesh
modules.no_render.name: NoRender
modules.no_render.desc: Hides overlays, HUD elements and world effects you pick
modules.no_render.HURT_CAM.name: Hurt camera
modules.no_render.HURT_CAM.tip: No camera tilt when you take damage or die
modules.no_render.PORTAL.name: Portal and nausea
modules.no_render.PORTAL.tip: No portal swirl, nausea overlay or screen warp
modules.no_render.FIRE.name: Fire
modules.no_render.LIQUID_OVERLAY.name: Liquid overlay
modules.no_render.LIQUID_OVERLAY.tip: No water texture over the screen underwater
modules.no_render.IN_WALL.name: In wall
modules.no_render.IN_WALL.tip: No black overlay with your head inside a block
modules.no_render.PUMPKIN.name: Pumpkin
modules.no_render.PUMPKIN.tip: No carved pumpkin blur while wearing one
modules.no_render.VIGNETTE.name: Vignette
modules.no_render.TOTEM.name: Totem animation
modules.no_render.TOTEM.tip: No item popping up in front of you when a totem triggers
modules.no_render.BOSS_BARS.name: Boss bars
modules.no_render.BOSS_BARS.tip: No boss bars at the top of the screen
modules.no_render.SCOREBOARD.name: Scoreboard
modules.no_render.POTION_ICONS.name: Potion icons
modules.no_render.POTION_ICONS.tip: No effect icons in the top right corner
modules.no_render.TITLES.name: Titles
modules.no_render.TITLES.tip: No title and subtitle text in the middle of the screen
modules.no_render.FOG.name: Fog
modules.no_render.FOG.tip: No distance fog in air, including a boss's world fog
modules.no_render.LIQUID_FOG.name: Liquid fog
modules.no_render.LIQUID_FOG.tip: No fog under water or in lava
modules.no_render.BLINDNESS.name: Blindness
modules.no_render.BLINDNESS.tip: No fog, dark sky or dimming from blindness and darkness
modules.no_render.BOSS_SKY.name: Boss sky
modules.no_render.BOSS_SKY.tip: No sky darkening or world fog from a boss bar
modules.no_render.WEATHER.name: Weather
modules.no_render.WEATHER.tip: No rain or snow and no rain splashes; the rain sound and the darker sky stay
modules.no_render.LIGHTNING.name: Lightning flash
modules.no_render.LIGHTNING.tip: No sky flash when lightning strikes
modules.freecam.name: Freecam
modules.freecam.desc: Detaches the camera and leaves your body where it stands
modules.freecam.SPEED.name: Speed
modules.freecam.SPEED.tip: Blocks per second the detached camera flies at
modules.freecam.SPRINT_SPEED.name: Sprint speed
modules.freecam.INPUT_MODE.name: Input mode
modules.freecam.INPUT_MODE.tip: Where left and right click go while detached. Player: what your body faces. Camera: the block or entity under the freecam's crosshair, within your body's reach. None: nowhere
modules.auto_mine.name: AutoMine
modules.auto_mine.desc: Digs a corridor straight ahead, or clears a box you mark out
modules.auto_mine.MODE.name: Mode
modules.auto_mine.MODE.tip: Corridor digs straight ahead. Area clears the box you mark with Define area, top down
modules.auto_mine.DEFINE.name: Define area
modules.auto_mine.DEFINE.tip: Closes this screen; left click a block for the first corner, right click for the second
modules.auto_mine.REACH.name: Reach
modules.auto_mine.REACH.tip: Adjacent mines only the blocks touching you. All mines everything in reach. 3x2 clears a 3 wide, 2 tall slice around you
modules.auto_mine.LENGTH.name: Length
modules.auto_mine.LENGTH.tip: Columns to dig before switching off, or 0 to keep going
modules.auto_mine.TURN.name: Turn speed
modules.auto_mine.TURN.tip: Degrees per second the aim may travel, rolled fresh inside this range for every block
modules.auto_mine.DELAY.name: Delay
modules.auto_mine.DELAY.tip: Milliseconds between one block breaking and the next being dug, rolled fresh inside this range
modules.auto_mine.FLUIDS.name: Fluids
modules.auto_mine.FLUIDS.tip: A block with lava or water behind it: Skip leaves it standing, Stop switches off. A corridor always stops
modules.auto_mine.INV_FULL.name: Inventory full
modules.auto_mine.INV_FULL.tip: Stop switches off with a chat line once nothing more fits; Ignore keeps mining and leaves the drops
modules.auto_mine.LOW_HEALTH.name: On low health
modules.auto_mine.LOW_HEALTH.tip: Disconnect leaves the server once health drops below the Health setting
modules.auto_mine.HEALTH.name: Health
modules.auto_mine.HEALTH.tip: Disconnect below this many half hearts. The bar stops at 20; type a larger number for more
modules.auto_mine.PROGRESS.name: Progress HUD
modules.auto_mine.PROGRESS.tip: Show a bar of how much of the area is cleared
modules.auto_mine.IN_GUI.name: Allow in GUI
modules.auto_mine.IN_GUI.tip: Keep digging while a screen is open, which no hand could do
modules.ore_miner.name: OreMiner
modules.ore_miner.desc: Walks to the nearest ore Xray, OreESP or Seed Xray shows and mines it
modules.ore_miner.ORES.name: Ores
modules.ore_miner.ORES.tip: Which ore families are mined; .mine <ore> narrows one run to one of them
modules.ore_miner.SOURCE.name: Source
modules.ore_miner.SOURCE.tip: Where the ores come from. Xray takes what Xray or OreESP draws, one of which must be on. Seed Xray takes its predictions and needs a seed. Auto uses Seed Xray while it is on with a seed, otherwise Xray
modules.ore_miner.RANGE.name: Range
modules.ore_miner.RANGE.tip: How far from you in blocks ores are looked for
modules.ore_miner.MIN_Y.name: Min Y
modules.ore_miner.MIN_Y.tip: The lowest y an ore is mined at
modules.ore_miner.MAX_Y.name: Max Y
modules.ore_miner.MAX_Y.tip: The highest y an ore is mined at
modules.ore_miner.DIG.name: Dig to ores
modules.ore_miner.DIG.tip: Dig through blocks where that is quicker than walking around. Off walks only
modules.ore_miner.VEIN.name: Follow veins
modules.ore_miner.VEIN.tip: After an ore breaks, mine the ores of the same kind touching it before looking further
modules.ore_miner.AMOUNT.name: Amount
modules.ore_miner.AMOUNT.tip: Ore blocks to mine before switching off, or 0 to keep going
modules.ore_miner.HOME.name: Return home
modules.ore_miner.HOME.tip: After the amount is mined, walk back to the home block before switching off
modules.ore_miner.SET_HOME.name: Set home here
modules.ore_miner.SET_HOME.tip: Stores the block you stand in as home; kept until you leave the server
modules.ore_miner.TURN.name: Turn speed
modules.ore_miner.TURN.tip: Degrees per second the aim may travel, rolled fresh inside this range for every block
modules.ore_miner.DELAY.name: Delay
modules.ore_miner.DELAY.tip: Milliseconds between one block breaking and the next being dug, rolled fresh inside this range
modules.ore_miner.FLUIDS.name: Fluids
modules.ore_miner.FLUIDS.tip: An ore with lava or water behind it: Skip leaves it standing, Stop switches off
modules.ore_miner.INV_FULL.name: Inventory full
modules.ore_miner.INV_FULL.tip: Stop switches off with a chat line once nothing more fits; Ignore keeps mining and leaves the drops
modules.ore_miner.LOW_HEALTH.name: On low health
modules.ore_miner.LOW_HEALTH.tip: Disconnect leaves the server once health drops below the Health setting
modules.ore_miner.HEALTH.name: Health
modules.ore_miner.HEALTH.tip: Disconnect below this many half hearts. The bar stops at 20; type a larger number for more
modules.ore_miner.IN_GUI.name: Allow in GUI
modules.ore_miner.IN_GUI.tip: Keep digging while a screen is open, which no hand could do
modules.builder.name: AutoBuild
modules.builder.desc: Builds the placed schematic block by block
modules.builder.MODE.name: Mode
modules.builder.MODE.tip: Legit turns the camera to every click. Fast sends Blocks per tick clicks with a look the camera does not show
modules.builder.BREAK.name: Break
modules.builder.BREAK.tip: All mismatches also clears blocks where the schematic has air. Only where a block goes leaves those standing
modules.builder.PER_TICK.name: Blocks per tick
modules.builder.PER_TICK.tip: Clicks sent per tick in Fast mode
modules.builder.DIG.name: Dig on the way
modules.builder.DIG.tip: Routes may dig through blocks where that is quicker than walking around. Off walks, pillars and bridges only
modules.builder.SCAFFOLD.name: Remove scaffolding
modules.builder.SCAFFOLD.tip: At the end, break the blocks routes put down outside the schematic
modules.builder.FLY.name: Fly in creative
modules.builder.FLY.tip: In creative, fly between spots instead of walking, pillaring and bridging; the flight you had is put back at the end
modules.builder.AIR.name: Air place
modules.builder.AIR.tip: Place blocks with nothing beside them by clicking the empty cell itself. Vanilla servers accept it; anti-cheat plugins may not
modules.builder.TURN.name: Turn speed
modules.builder.TURN.tip: Degrees per second the aim may travel, rolled fresh inside this range for every block
modules.builder.DELAY.name: Delay
modules.builder.DELAY.tip: Milliseconds before each block is placed or dug, rolled fresh inside this range
modules.builder.IN_GUI.name: Allow in GUI
modules.builder.IN_GUI.tip: Keep building while a screen is open, which no hand could do
modules.builder.FLUIDS.name: Fluids
modules.builder.FLUIDS.tip: Pour the schematic's water and lava with buckets, waterlog blocks, and take away sources where air goes. Off leaves fluids as they are
modules.builder.REFILL.name: Refill water
modules.builder.REFILL.tip: In survival, once every water bucket is poured, fill the empty ones at a water source that refills itself, then go on
modules.farmer.name: AutoFarm
modules.farmer.desc: Harvests the crop around where you switch it on, then walks back there and stops
modules.farmer.CROP.name: Crop
modules.farmer.CROP.tip: What is harvested. Sugar cane breaks the second block of every stalk two or more high and leaves the bottom block to grow
modules.farmer.RANGE.name: Range
modules.farmer.RANGE.tip: How far from where it was switched on, in blocks across the ground, stalks are harvested. Read when it switches on
modules.farmer.COLLECT.name: Collect drops
modules.farmer.COLLECT.tip: After the last stalk, walk to the dropped items of the crop in range before going back
modules.farmer.TURN.name: Turn speed
modules.farmer.TURN.tip: Degrees per second the aim may travel, rolled fresh inside this range for every block
modules.farmer.DELAY.name: Delay
modules.farmer.DELAY.tip: Ticks to wait after a stalk breaks before the next is hit
modules.farmer.RENDER.name: Render
modules.farmer.RENDER.tip: Show the start block, the stalk being broken and the nearest stalks to go in the world
modules.farmer.HUD.name: Progress HUD
modules.farmer.HUD.tip: Show the state, the stalks harvested and to go, and a bar of the share done
modules.farmer.IN_GUI.name: Allow in GUI
modules.farmer.IN_GUI.tip: Keep harvesting while a screen is open, which no hand could do
modules.scaffold.name: Scaffold
modules.scaffold.desc: Places blocks under you as you walk off edges
modules.scaffold.MODE.name: Mode
modules.scaffold.MODE.tip: Legit only sneaks at edges. GodBridge places under you with a look the camera does not show. TellyBridge jumps and fills your starting layer from the air
modules.scaffold.DELAY.name: Delay
modules.scaffold.DELAY.tip: Ticks to wait after a placement before the next
modules.scaffold.AUTO_BLOCK.name: AutoBlock
modules.scaffold.AUTO_BLOCK.tip: Select the hotbar slot with the most usable blocks when you are not holding any, and go back on disable
modules.scaffold.EXPAND.name: Expand
modules.scaffold.EXPAND.tip: How close in blocks you must be to a side of your block before the hole beside it is filled. 0 never
modules.scaffold.TOWER.name: Tower
modules.scaffold.TOWER.tip: How you climb while jump is held: Jump and Step jump every ground tick, Motion launches at 0.42 and pulls down past a block, Smooth jumps every third ground tick
modules.scaffold.BLOCKS.name: Blocks
modules.scaffold.BLOCKS.tip: Which blocks may be used: any, all but the filter, or only the filter
modules.scaffold.FILTER.name: Filter blocks
modules.scaffold.FILTER.tip: The blocks Blacklist leaves out or Whitelist allows
modules.scaffold.PITCH_CHECK.name: Pitch check
modules.scaffold.PITCH_CHECK.tip: Only work while you look down at least Pitch angle
modules.scaffold.PITCH_ANGLE.name: Pitch angle
modules.scaffold.PITCH_ANGLE.tip: Degrees below level your camera must look
modules.scaffold.BLOCK_COUNT.name: Block count
modules.scaffold.BLOCK_COUNT.tip: Show how many of the held block you carry, under the crosshair
modules.scaffold.SNEAK_DELAY.name: Sneak delay
modules.scaffold.SNEAK_DELAY.tip: Milliseconds the edge sneak is held after the edge, rolled fresh inside this range for each sneak
modules.scaffold.REQUIRE_SNEAK.name: Require sneak
modules.scaffold.REQUIRE_SNEAK.tip: Only sneak at edges while you hold sneak, and lift your sneak away from them
modules.scaffold.ACTIVATION.name: Activation blocks
modules.scaffold.ACTIVATION.tip: Blocks you must place by hand under you before it takes over. 0 starts at once
modules.scaffold.REQUIRE_RIGHT_CLICK.tip: Only bridge while the use key is held
modules.scaffold.Y_INCREASE.name: Y increase
modules.scaffold.Y_INCREASE.tip: Blocks a jump may climb above the starting layer before placing stops, one more or less now and then
modules.scaffold.TURN.name: Turn speed
modules.scaffold.TURN.tip: Degrees per tick the sent look may turn, rolled fresh inside this range every tick
modules.scaffold.REACH.name: Reach
modules.scaffold.REACH.tip: Blocks from your eye a click may reach. The server allows your block reach, 4.5 in survival, plus 1
modules.flight.name: Flight
modules.flight.desc: Flies without the server having granted it, at creative speed
modules.flight.SPEED.name: Speed
modules.flight.SPEED.tip: Flying speed, where 0.05 is what creative mode gives you and sprinting doubles it
modules.flight.ANTI_KICK.name: Anti kick
modules.flight.ANTI_KICK.tip: How the server's floating counter is reset: Drop falls for a tick, Packet reports a fall that did not happen
modules.flight.EVERY.name: Anti kick every
modules.flight.EVERY.tip: Ticks of flight between resets, well under the 80 a server allows
modules.flight.FOR.name: Anti kick for
modules.flight.FOR.tip: Ticks each reset lasts, which under Drop is how far you sag. Packet always uses at least 3
modules.sneak.name: Sneak
modules.sneak.desc: Holds sneak on whether or not the key is pressed
modules.auto_walk.name: AutoWalk
modules.auto_walk.desc: Holds forward on whether or not the key is pressed
modules.auto_walk.PAUSE_ON_SCREEN.name: Pause on screen
modules.auto_walk.PAUSE_ON_SCREEN.tip: Stop walking while a screen is open, as a hand on the keys would
modules.auto_walk.SPRINT.name: Sprint
modules.auto_walk.AUTO_JUMP.name: Auto jump
modules.auto_walk.AUTO_JUMP.tip: Jump up one-block steps in the way, as the Auto-Jump option does, whatever that option is set to
modules.no_fall.name: NoFall
modules.no_fall.desc: Reports you as standing on the ground while you fall, so the server charges no fall damage
modules.no_fall.PAUSE_ON_MACE.name: Pause on mace
modules.no_fall.PAUSE_ON_MACE.tip: Take the fall while holding a mace, whose smash attack is paid for with the distance fallen
modules.vclip.name: VClip
modules.vclip.desc: Moves you straight up or down by a set number of blocks, then switches itself off
modules.vclip.DISTANCE.name: Distance
modules.vclip.DISTANCE.tip: Whole blocks to move, negative for down. Past 20 a vanilla server puts you back
modules.velocity.name: Velocity
modules.velocity.desc: Ignores knockback, cobwebs and water drag
modules.velocity.KNOCKBACK.name: Attack knockback
modules.velocity.KNOCKBACK.tip: Drop the motion the server sends when you are hit, which also covers wind charges, fishing rods and launch pads
modules.velocity.EXPLOSIONS.name: Explosion knockback
modules.velocity.EXPLOSIONS.tip: Drop the push from TNT, creepers, crystals and beds, which some servers also use for hits
modules.velocity.NO_WEB.name: No web
modules.velocity.NO_WEB.tip: Walk and fall through cobwebs at full speed
modules.velocity.NO_WATER_DRAG.name: No water drag
modules.velocity.NO_WATER_DRAG.tip: Move through water at land speed, as three levels of Depth Strider would on the bottom
modules.pathfinder.name: Pathfinder
modules.pathfinder.desc: Settings for .goto and .follow routes; they apply whether this is on or off
modules.pathfinder.PARKOUR.name: Parkour
modules.pathfinder.PARKOUR.tip: Let .goto and .follow plan sprint jumps across gaps
modules.pathfinder.DIG.name: Dig
modules.pathfinder.DIG.tip: Let .goto and .follow break blocks where that is quicker than walking around
modules.pathfinder.PLACE.name: Place
modules.pathfinder.PLACE.tip: Let .goto and .follow pillar up and bridge gaps with throwaway blocks you carry
modules.pathfinder.THROWAWAY.name: Throwaway blocks
modules.pathfinder.THROWAWAY.tip: Blocks a route may place; the first in this list that you carry is used
modules.pathfinder.TURN_SPEED.name: Turn speed
modules.pathfinder.TURN_SPEED.tip: Degrees per second the camera turns toward where a route looks
modules.pathfinder.FOLLOW_DISTANCE.name: Follow distance
modules.pathfinder.FOLLOW_DISTANCE.tip: Blocks from the player's feet .follow stops at
modules.pathfinder.AVOID_HAZARDS.name: Avoid hazards
modules.pathfinder.AVOID_HAZARDS.tip: Keep every route out of and away from lava, fire, magma, cactus, berry bushes, wither roses and downward bubble columns
modules.pathfinder.MAX_FALL.name: Max fall
modules.pathfinder.MAX_FALL.tip: Longest drop a route takes onto dry ground; above 3 the fall hurts, drops into deep enough water are always allowed
modules.auto_sell.name: AutoSell
modules.auto_sell.desc: Types the sell command whenever a chosen item is in your inventory
modules.auto_sell.ITEMS.name: Items
modules.auto_sell.ITEMS.tip: Which items are sold whenever one turns up in your inventory
modules.auto_sell.COMMAND.name: Command
modules.auto_sell.COMMAND.tip: Sent once per sale, %s replaced with the item's id. A leading / is optional and stripped either way
modules.gamemode_notifier.name: GamemodeNotifier
modules.gamemode_notifier.desc: Says in chat when another player's gamemode changes
modules.gamemode_notifier.SURVIVAL.name: Survival
modules.gamemode_notifier.CREATIVE.name: Creative
modules.gamemode_notifier.ADVENTURE.name: Adventure
modules.gamemode_notifier.SPECTATOR.name: Spectator
modules.coord_logger.name: CoordLogger
modules.coord_logger.desc: Says where withers spawn, dragons die and end portals open. 26.2 servers send only the direction past 32 blocks; older ones may send the position
modules.coord_logger.WITHER.name: Wither spawns
modules.coord_logger.DRAGON.name: Dragon deaths
modules.coord_logger.END_PORTAL.name: End portals
modules.coord_logger.LINE.name: Draw direction
modules.coord_logger.LINE.tip: Draw a line toward an event the server gave only a direction for
modules.coord_logger.LINE_SECONDS.name: Line seconds
modules.coord_logger.LINE_SECONDS.tip: How long the direction line stays
modules.special.name: Special
modules.special.desc: Cuts a typed phrase out of chat lines, formatting codes ignored
modules.special.PHRASE.name: Phrase
modules.special.PHRASE.tip: Cut out of every chat line, wherever it appears
modules.commands.name: Commands
modules.commands.desc: Runs chat lines that start with the prefix as client commands instead of sending them
modules.commands.PREFIX.name: Prefix
modules.commands.PREFIX.tip: What a line starts with to be run here rather than sent. Never /
modules.better_tooltips.name: BetterTooltips
modules.better_tooltips.desc: Adds previews and extra rows to item tooltips
modules.better_tooltips.DISPLAY_WHEN.tip: Keybind shows previews only while the preview key is held, Always shows them on every tooltip
modules.better_tooltips.PREVIEW_KEY.name: Preview key
modules.better_tooltips.PREVIEW_KEY.tip: Hold this over an item to see its preview
modules.better_tooltips.CONTAINERS.name: Containers
modules.better_tooltips.CONTAINERS.tip: Preview a shulker box's or other container item's contents as a grid of slots
modules.better_tooltips.COMPACT_CONTAINE: List a container's contents merged by item, most first, instead of slot by slot
modules.better_tooltips.BOOKS.name: Books
modules.better_tooltips.BOOKS.tip: Preview the first page of a book
modules.better_tooltips.BANNERS.name: Banners
modules.better_tooltips.BANNERS.tip: Preview a banner, a patterned shield or a banner pattern's design, enlarged
modules.better_tooltips.MAPS.name: Maps
modules.better_tooltips.MAPS.tip: Preview a map's picture, once the server has sent it
modules.better_tooltips.MAP_SCALE.name: Map scale
modules.better_tooltips.MAP_SCALE.tip: Size of the map preview: 1 is 128 GUI pixels, the size of a map held in hand
modules.better_tooltips.BUCKETS.name: Buckets
modules.better_tooltips.BUCKETS.tip: Show a bucketed mob's variant, size, age and health
modules.better_tooltips.STATUS_EFFECTS.t: List the effects a food or a suspicious stew gives, with their chance
modules.better_tooltips.FOOD_VALUES.name: Food values
modules.better_tooltips.FOOD_VALUES.tip: Show a food's hunger and saturation as rows of icons at the bottom of its tooltip, as AppleSkin does
modules.better_tooltips.SHOW_HIDDEN_TOOL: Show the tooltip of an item whose tooltip the server hid
modules.better_tooltips.SHOW_HIDDEN_COMP: Show the rows the server hid, such as enchantments, lore and attributes
modules.spam.name: Spam
modules.spam.desc: Sends a message over and over, a delay apart, with random text around it if you like
modules.spam.MESSAGE.name: Message
modules.spam.MESSAGE.tip: Sent every time. A leading / runs it as a command
modules.spam.DELAY.name: Delay
modules.spam.DELAY.tip: Ticks between messages, 20 to a second, rolled fresh inside this range. Under 20 for long gets you kicked, and a lagging server needs more
modules.spam.PREFIX.name: Prefix
modules.spam.PREFIX.tip: Put random letters and digits and a space before the message. Skipped for a command
modules.spam.PREFIX_LENGTH.name: Prefix length
modules.spam.PREFIX_LENGTH.tip: How many random characters go in front, rolled inside this range
modules.spam.SUFFIX.name: Suffix
modules.spam.SUFFIX.tip: Put a space and random letters and digits after the message
modules.spam.SUFFIX_LENGTH.name: Suffix length
modules.spam.SUFFIX_LENGTH.tip: How many random characters go after, rolled inside this range
modules.speed.name: Speed
modules.speed.SPEED.name: Speed
modules.speed.IN_LIQUIDS.name: In liquids
modules.speed.IN_LIQUIDS.tip: Toggle to apply while in water or lava
modules.speed.ONLY_ON_GROUND.name: Only on ground
modules.speed.ONLY_ON_GROUND.tip: Only apply while standing on a block
modules.ui_utils.name: UiUtils
modules.ui_utils.desc: UI-Utils' container buttons: close or de-sync a screen without the server agreeing, hold back or drop click packets, save a screen and forge clicks
modules.ui_utils.RESTORE_KEY.name: Restore GUI key
modules.ui_utils.RESTORE_KEY.tip: Reopens the screen kept by Save GUI, with no screen open
modules.ui_utils.BYPASS_PACK.name: Bypass resource pack
modules.ui_utils.BYPASS_PACK.tip: Answer a required server resource pack as accepted and loaded without downloading it
modules.ui_utils.FORCE_DENY.name: Force deny
modules.ui_utils.FORCE_DENY.tip: Bypass optional resource packs too, not only required ones
